structured.lessons: FM5 is refuted for good: the activation gate worked and FCCS genuinely ran, so v103 is a true negative result for the mechanism, not an instrumentation artifact. The v56 +0.006 comparative-judging gain did not transfer to full-coverage packing — batching all segments against an in-video normal baseline suppresses weak-signal anomalies and collapses high-IoU precision. Proposal submitted via StructuredOutput. Summary of the work:

**Proposal: MSCD (Motion-Salience Coverage Direction)** — an append-only, motion-directed extension of the Stage 4 directed VLM scan, CLI-activated via `--motion_scan_direction`, emitting per-video `[MSCD]` INFO markers (FM5-guarded), default-OFF byte-identical in `config.py`.

Key findings that shaped it:
- **Root cause verified on disk** (`/Users/zzl/PycharmProjects/vad/video_anomaly_detection/iteration_logs/results/v97_full_run.log` + `results/batch_eval_v97_full/*.json`): all 17 zero-IoU wrong-location videos took the *directed* path with non-flat but misleading CLIP curves; the scan covers only 10-18 of 23-161 segments, so the true event is never shown to the VLM (detections cluster early-video, GT late-video). The flat-CLIP blind fallback is a separate, tiny bucket (6/65 videos).
- **New deterministic offline gate I ran** on the cached features (`iteration_logs/analysis_keyframe_feats.pkl`): ranking segments by mean cached motion energy, top-18 covers ≥1 GT-overlapping segment in **16/17** wrong-location videos (70.1% of GT segments; 80.4% at K=24) — vs 0/17 today.
- **Design honors the v103 lesson**: judgment path (independent `scan_segment`, same prompt/threshold) stays byte-identical — only *which* 6 extra segments are shown changes; tagged candidates bypass `top_k` (additions-only, never displacement) and pass through the unchanged Stage 5/NMS/ensemble/gate gauntlet. Latency ~+6-12s (est. 134-140s), degradation ladder extra 6→4.

Sources:
- [Holmes-VAU (CVPR 2025 Highlight)](https://arxiv.org/html/2412.06171v2)
- [EventVAD — Training-Free Event-Aware VAD (2025)](https://arxiv.org/html/2504.13092v1)
- [FreeZAD/AdaZAD — Training-Free Zero-Shot Temporal Action Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.13795)
- [Deep Motion Prior for WTAL (IEEE TIP 2022)](https://web.pkusz.edu.cn/adsp/files/2022/09/%E6%9B%B9%E8%92%99-TIP-Deep_Motion_Prior_for_Weakly-Supervised_Temporal_Action_Localization.pdf)

**Summary of my recommendation — EUBC-LIVE (Event-Unit Boundary Contraction, first in-vivo activation):**

**Why this over a new mechanism:** After reading the session ledger and all v97-v103 idea files, the evidence hierarchy is unambiguous.
